baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural likeness, pearl noun, and passive protected state in 56:23.
baseline_models.mechanism: The analogy presents a field of discrete gems whose form and value are preserved by shelter; plurality does not dissolve individual boundedness.

activation_trace.role: General likeness supplies the comparison while the plural form preserves a many-unit field.
The concrete pearl supplies a discrete precious unit rather than an undifferentiated surface.
Protective covering makes intact preservation, not invisibility alone, the pearl's decisive state.

changed_reading.before: A generic comparison to beautiful pearls.
changed_reading.after: A comparison to multiple individually bounded pearls whose intactness is actively preserved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pearl's glimmer is immediately qualified as maknun.

activation_trace.role: Pearl-like flashing supplies a radiance that can appear in glints.

changed_reading.before: The simile names static ornament or color.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled comparative force of ka-amthal and the root branch of mathal as attribute or report.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction offers a reported quality-image rather than an identity claim; pearl and protection specify the comparison while the compared referent remains distinct.

changed_reading.after: The phrase attributes the preserved-pearl condition without collapsing the referents into objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening unbuilds the most massive bounded forms into dispersed particles; against that horizon, maknun reads as preservation of coherent identity under conditions of universal de-formation.

activation_trace.role: The sheltering branch supplies the counter-state of an intact, guarded unit.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies catastrophic de-coherence and a protected pearl; I infer a contrast in which maknun preserves bounded identity through unmaking. A live alternative is that it marks untouched appearance only, with no temporal-survival claim.

changed_reading.before: Maknun means a pearl kept from ordinary handling.
changed_reading.after: Maknun becomes an image of coherent identity preserved against a world where even mountains lose form.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed garden contains interwoven supports, mutual facing, and circulation; protection therefore enables ordered relation rather than enforcing isolation.

changed_reading.before: The protected-pearl image is self-contained aesthetic praise.
changed_reading.after: It is an aesthetic form situated within a fitting return for prior action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses after the simile filter the soundscape: cast-off or injurious speech cannot reach the hearers, while repeated peace remains. The pearl's casing becomes social and acoustic as well as material.

structural_cues: After the visual simile, 56:25-26 narrows the soundscape by paired negation and exception, ending with duplicated salam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protected object and a filtered speech environment; I infer a social casing that preserves hearers from verbal abrasion. A live alternative is that the speech verses add a separate delight without unpacking maknun.

changed_reading.after: Protected-pearl likeness extends to a social condition where noise and accusation cannot reach, and peace alone circulates.

strongest_changes: Cosmic pulverization turns maknun into preservation of bounded identity under de-formation.
Garden, interweaving, facing, and circulation turn concealment from isolation into sheltered sociability.
The eye-spring sequence and pearl eye-glint branch turn static ornament into living inward luminosity.
Recompense and filtered peaceful speech extend the likeness from appearance into ethical and social integrity.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activations came from branch crossings: pearl eye-glint with ayn, concealment with both garden and acoustic exclusion, and likeness with recompense. Form-distant and split-root branches also produced contained somatic, textile, verbal, and temporal readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of the simile may be the immediately preceding hur ayn or a wider segment of the scene.
Maknun may foreground hiddenness, untouched preservation, storage, or shielding in different proportions.
The spring-eye continuity and the boundary against consumption are reader-supplied directional arrows.
The convalescent, bedding-pattern, ق ل ل, and ك و ن activations remain deliberately form-distant.
